feedback.comment: Best facial I've had in Bangalore.
Colour turned out darker than discussed.

googleReviews.author: Priya Mehta
googleReviews.comment: Booked a colour correction here after seeing the listing on Maps. Stylists listened and the finish was exactly what I asked for.

googleReviews.author: Rohit Bansal
googleReviews.comment: Clean salon, easy parking nearby. Haircut was good — slightly busy on Saturday evenings.

googleReviews.author: Ananya Joshi
googleReviews.comment: Found this outlet on Google Maps. Keratin treatment was worth it and staff explained aftercare clearly.

googleReviews.author: Karthik Iyer
googleReviews.comment: Premium vibe on 100 Feet Road. Facial was relaxing and they confirmed the slot on WhatsApp after I called from Maps.

googleReviews.author: Sohini Das
googleReviews.comment: Good bridal trial. A little wait at reception but the result photographed beautifully.

googleReviews.author: Meera Shah
googleReviews.comment: Tiny studio, excellent blow-dry. Glad I trusted the Maps reviews.
